limitations: Only the first GUE pivot with a fixed planar comparison exponent, and no uniform claim as q approaches two; no theorem about full permutation, later pivots, or numerical stability.
scientific_integrity: All claimed constants arise from exact angular Gaussian probability, saddle expansions, half-normal Mills asymptotics and a regularly varying Laplace transfer. One self-review passed; external validation has not been performed. No independent novelty certification is asserted.
title: Three regimes for Gaussian-unitary first-pivot probabilities under planar \(\ell^q\) norms
